emplacement: Ouverture de la page L'atelier (pleine largeur, texte à gauche)
alt: Des mains découpent une photo imprimée au cutter sur un tapis de coupe
scene: cutting out a printed photograph of a sunny coastline with a precision craft knife on a green self-healing cutting mat, a steel ruler, small paper cut-outs of clouds and palm leaves, a sheet of white mount board, everything placed in the right half of the frame

alt: Une planche de carton blanc rainurée au cutter le long d'une règle
scene: scoring a sheet of thick white mount board with a craft knife along a steel ruler, a few precisely cut white board strips and corner pieces of a small shallow box laid out unassembled next to it

alt: Une petite vitre rayée au coupe-verre le long d'une règle
scene: scoring a small rectangular pane of clear glass with a glass cutter along a steel ruler on a grey felt-covered table, a soft reflection on the glass

alt: Des éléments découpés dans des photos, rangés sur l'établi, une pince fine
scene: picking up a small paper cut-out with fine tweezers among neat rows of cut-out photo paper elements: clouds, leaves, tiny birds, a strip of green hills, a little sailboat, nothing assembled, no people in the prints

alt: Une pincée de sable versée dans un petit plateau, des coquillages et du gazon à côté
scene: pouring a pinch of fine golden sand from a small glass jar into a shallow white paper tray, a few small seashells and a tuft of artificial grass next to it

alt: Du sable fin et doré, en gros plan
consigne_scene: Straight-on macro photograph of fine golden beach sand with a few tiny pale pebbles, filling the whole frame edge to edge, soft raking light revealing every grain.

alt: De petits coquillages clairs
consigne_scene: Top-down macro photograph of dozens of small pale seashells, cockles and tiny spirals, scattered evenly over fine sand, filling the whole frame edge to edge, soft raking light.

alt: Du gazon synthétique vert, en gros plan
consigne_scene: Straight-on macro photograph of short bright green artificial grass, dense even blades, filling the whole frame edge to edge, soft raking light, slight depth of field.

alt: De la fausse fourrure crème, toute douce
consigne_scene: Straight-on macro photograph of soft cream faux fur with long silky fibres gently swirling, filling the whole frame edge to edge, warm soft raking light.

emplacement: Section « Carine et l'atelier » (photo en hauteur)
alt: Un coin d'établi : bocaux de sable et de coquillages, chutes de carton blanc, cutter et tapis de coupe
consigne_scene: A corner of a tidy home craft workbench seen from slightly above: small glass jars of golden sand and seashells, offcuts of white mount board, a roll of kraft paper, a green cutting mat with a craft knife and a steel ruler, nothing being made, no people, no hands.

emplacement: Ouverture de la page Contact (à droite du texte)
alt: Une enveloppe kraft, des photos imprimées retournées et un stylo sur un bureau clair
consigne_scene: A kraft paper envelope, a small stack of printed photographs lying face down so that nothing is visible on them, a fountain pen and a blank note card on a pale oak desk, nothing else, no people, no hands, no text anywhere.

alt: Un carton kraft ouvert et vide, du papier de soie froissé
